account_sign_out_failed: We couldn't sign you out. Check your connection and try again.

account_error_timeout: Deskohub is taking too long to answer. Check your connection and try again.
account_error_rate_limited: You've refreshed a lot in a short time. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
